configs.title: Strip exfiltration vectors from model output
configs.note: Markdown images auto-load and can leak data in the URL.

import re
IMG = re.compile(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\((?!https://cdn\.mycompany\.com/)[^)]*\)")
def sanitize(md: str) -> str:
    md = IMG.sub("[image removed]", md)
    return md

configs.title: FastAPI SSE streaming endpoint
configs.note: Disable proxy buffering and detect disconnects to stop paying for tokens nobody reads.
configs.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/chat")
async def chat(req: Request, body: ChatIn):
    async def gen():
        async for chunk in llm_stream(body.messages):
            if await req.is_disconnected():
                break
            yield f"data: {chunk.json()}\n\n"
        yield "data: [DONE]\n\n"
    return StreamingResponse(gen(), media_type="text/event-stream",
                             headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"})

configs.title: Redis token bucket (atomic Lua)
configs.note: KEYS[1]=bucket key; ARGV = capacity, refill_per_sec, now_ms, cost.
configs.code:
local cap, rate, now, cost = tonumber(ARGV[1]), tonumber(ARGV[2]), tonumber(ARGV[3]), tonumber(ARGV[4])
local d = redis.call('HMGET', KEYS[1], 't', 'ts')
local tokens = tonumber(d[1]) or cap
local ts = tonumber(d[2]) or now
tokens = math.min(cap, tokens + (now - ts) / 1000 * rate)
local ok = tokens >= cost
if ok then tokens = tokens - cost end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 't', tokens, 'ts', now)
redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], math.ceil(cap / rate * 1000) * 2)
return ok and 1 or 0

configs.title: Multi-stage, non-root Python Dockerfile
configs.note: Small image, cached dependency layer, no root.
configs.code:
FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /bin/uv
WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project
COPY src ./src
RUN uv sync --frozen --no-dev

FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN useradd -r -u 10001 app
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app /app
ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH" PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK CMD python -c "import urllib.request as u;u.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/healthz')"
CMD ["uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

configs.title: Kubernetes Deployment for a GPU inference server
configs.note: Long startup probe because model loading is slow; shared memory for the engine.
configs.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: vllm }
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: vllm } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: vllm } }
    spec:
      tolerations: [{ key: nvidia.com/gpu, operator: Exists, effect: NoSchedule }]
      containers:
        - name: vllm
          image: vllm/vllm-openai:latest
          args: ["--model", "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct", "--enable-prefix-caching"]
          ports: [{ containerPort: 8000 }]
          resources:
            limits: { nvidia.com/gpu: 1, memory: 48Gi }
            requests: { cpu: "6", memory: 32Gi }
          startupProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: 8000 }
            failureThreshold: 60
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: 8000 }
          volumeMounts: [{ name: shm, mountPath: /dev/shm }]
      volumes:
        - name: shm
          emptyDir: { medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 8Gi }

configs.title: KEDA: autoscale on queue depth
configs.note: Scale workers by backlog, not CPU. Works for agent workers and batch inference.
configs.code:
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata: { name: agent-workers }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { name: agent-workers }
  minReplicaCount: 1
  maxReplicaCount: 40
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  triggers:
    - type: redis
      metadata:
        address: redis:6379
        listName: agent_jobs
        listLength: "5"

configs.title: GitHub Actions CI with OIDC (no long-lived keys)
configs.note: Tests, then eval gate, then image build.
configs.code:
name: ci
on: { pull_request: {}, push: { branches: [main] } }
permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
      - run: uv sync --frozen
      - run: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest
      - run: uv run pytest evals/ --maxfail=1   # LLM eval gate
  build:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci, aws-region: us-east-1 }
      - run: docker build -t $REGISTRY/app:${{ github.sha }} . && docker push $REGISTRY/app:${{ github.sha }}

configs.title: Prometheus alerts for an LLM service
configs.note: Alert on symptoms users feel, plus cost.
configs.code:
groups:
- name: llm
  rules:
  - alert: HighTTFTp95
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(llm_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 2
    for: 10m
    labels: { severity: page }
  - alert: ErrorBudgetBurn
    expr: sum(rate(llm_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(rate(llm_requests_total[1h])) > 0.02
    for: 5m
    labels: { severity: page }
  - alert: TokenSpendSpike
    expr: sum(rate(llm_tokens_total[15m])) > 3 * sum(rate(llm_tokens_total[15m] offset 1d))
    for: 15m
    labels: { severity: ticket }

configs.title: Design doc template
configs.note: Use this for interviews and for real work.
configs.code:
# <System> design

## 1. Context and goals
Who uses it, why now, what success looks like. Non-goals.

## 2. Requirements
Functional / non-functional (latency p95, availability, durability, cost ceiling).

## 3. Scale and estimates
DAU, QPS (avg/peak), storage/year, bandwidth, tokens/day, GPUs.

## 4. API and data model
Endpoints, request/response, schemas, keys, indexes.

## 5. High-level architecture
Diagram + the read path and the write path.

## 6. Deep dives
Bottleneck 1, bottleneck 2, with alternatives and trade-offs.

## 7. Failure modes
What breaks, blast radius, detection, mitigation, degradation plan.

## 8. Security, privacy, cost

## 9. Rollout and observability
SLOs, dashboards, canary plan.

## 10. Alternatives considered and open questions

configs.title: Estimation worksheet
configs.note: Fill these in at the start of every design.
configs.code:
Users:           DAU = __   peak concurrency = __
Requests:        avg QPS = DAU * req/user / 86400 = __   peak = avg * 3 = __
Storage:         bytes/record * records/day * 365 * replicas = __
Bandwidth:       QPS * payload = __ MB/s
LLM tokens:      reqs/day * (in + out tokens) = __ tokens/day -> $ = __
GPU sizing:      peak tok/s needed / tok/s per GPU = __ GPUs (+30% headroom)
Cache:           working set * hit target -> memory = __ GB

configs.title: Idempotent write with outbox (SQL)
configs.note: The state change and the event commit atomically; a relay publishes the event.

configs.title: Snowflake-style ID generator
configs.note: 64-bit IDs: 41 bits time, 10 bits worker, 12 bits sequence. Sortable and no coordination at write time.

configs.title: Consistent hash ring with virtual nodes
configs.note: Adding or removing a node moves about 1/N of the keys instead of nearly all of them.

configs.title: Circuit breaker
configs.note: Fail fast while a dependency is down, then probe carefully before closing again.

configs.title: URL shortener schema
configs.note: Read-heavy and key-value shaped. Base62 of a unique ID avoids collisions without a lookup.
